source: The structure the synthetic demo product behind examples/migration-map/demo is measured against. It follows the shape of docs/angular-structure.json, the project's decided structure, with one rule per folder the demo has.
note: Ordered rule list, first match wins; scripts/angular-structure.mjs applies it and scripts/migration-map.mjs --measure records the result in migration-metrics.json.

usage.purpose: Decides `placeByUsage`: the domains of the files that use a React original, found by walking its importers up until each path reaches a file with a domain.

preprocess.note: A file in an `angular` folder beside its React parent lands where that parent's rule sends it, keeping its name.

rules.reason: A store adapter lives with the one domain that uses it, and in `core/store/` when several do.
A pure helper is imported by Angular where it is.
A React-bound helper keeps its role in the shared utils folder.
Design-system primitives are reused across every domain.
Every feature folder is a page of exactly one domain.
